title: Steelers to replace Acrisure Stadium grass after poor home field grade in 2026 NFLPA survey

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Steelers to replace Acrisure Stadium grass after poor home field grade in 2026 NFLPA survey
sources.description: The Steelers' field received an F- grade from players in this year's report cards and will be re-sodded with a new surface.
